fichas.title: Indoor tennis halls
fichas.summary: Indoor tennis halls may be demountable, permanent, or convertible. The text gives international and recommended playing-height requirements, court and hall dimensions, and possible configurations for one, two, or three courts. It notes that reducing the built area can restrict use. Figures show hall-height sections, hall forms, a ground-floor plan, and permanent halls over one or more courts.
